{{Quote|Freighter, this is a '''reserved bay!''' You belong on an '''exterior docking gantry''' and-- freighter, your approach is '''too fast!'''|Flight controller|<ref name="MSW18" />}}
'''Docking Bay 31''' was one of many docking bays and gantries aboard [[The Wheel/Legends|the ''Wheel'']].

==History==
It was the docking bay used by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to land the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], while being chased by [[Sector Commander]] [[Zertik Strom/Legends|Zertik Strom]]. At that time, it was a reserved bay.

After being ransacked for smuggling goods and after encountering several life-threatening situation, Solo managed to lift off from the bay again and leave the Wheel behind.
